content: {"like":["Returning cast members from the OVA were retained, which the reviewer appreciated.","The performances of Lisa Ortiz (Deedlit), Crispin Freeman (Spark), Angora Deb (Leaf), and Greg Wolfe (Greevus) were highlighted as strong points.","The video quality of the dub was noted as noticeably better than the CPM DVD set, though not as pristine as the OVA."],"dislike":["Frequent vocal dropouts and cast replacements throughout the series, especially for Deedlit, Garrack, and other characters.","Inconsistent and weak performances from many incidental and supporting characters due to budget cuts and rushed dubbing.","The overall lack of consistency and quality in the dub, leading to a mixed and patchy experience.","The awkward and sometimes saccharine dialogue, particularly in the LODOSS ISLAND shorts and certain character lines.","The reviewer’s preference for the OVA dub over the CHRONICLES dub in terms of flow, performance, and overall execution."]}
